title: Words of Greek origin

summary_es.en: ps-, pn-, gn-, mn-: silent or simplified letters in learned words.
summary_es.fr: ps-, pn-, gn-, mn- : lettres muettes ou simplifiées dans les mots savants.
summary_es.zh: ps-、pn-、gn-、mn-：学术词中不发音或简化的字母。
summary_es.ja: ps-, pn-, gn-, mn-：学術語での無音・簡略化された文字。

tip_es: In words of Greek origin the first consonant of a group such as “ps-”, “pn-”, “gn-” or “mn-” is often simplified in speech: psicología is usually said “sicología” and pneumonía is said “neumonía”. Both spellings are accepted by the Real Academia. Read the word as it is written and also as it is spoken.
